interpretation_boundary: message_off / message_shuffle are post-training input interventions. They measure sensitivity to the real message correspondence, not a causal generalisation gain, and they are not equivalent to an independently trained capacity-matched STATIC control.

protocol.note: message_off / message_shuffle create out-of-distribution inputs; they measure sensitivity to the real message correspondence, not a causal generalisation gain
